proposal.reason: Primary change is communicator configuration control: new config fields are validated/defaulted, overridden from environment, stored on comm, and synchronized across ranks. Device-topology also needs review because P2P channel-per-peer and max-peer budgeting logic now uses topology/NIC bandwidth and new peer caps. Enqueue needs review because strong-stream graph-capture/mixing semantics changed (graphUsageMode-aware acquire/release and capture handling), which is a substantive runtime stream-planning behavior change rather than mechanical call-site edits.
